content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [product_name] with a [product_name] display and want to set up an alarm page sourced from [product_name]. I can build the alarm page on the display, but I'm having trouble getting the messages from [product_name] to appear on the screen. Any suggestions?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to connect an alarm function between a [company_name] [product_name] and a [product_name] HMI display. The main challenge is that, although the alarm page is created on the display device, alarms generated within [product_name] do not show up as intended. This highlights possible communication or configuration limitations between the devices, or a setup gap for linking alarm functionality correctly.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily configure the display so that it shows real-time alarm messages sent from [product_name], allowing alarm outputs to be seamlessly displayed on the HMI's alarm page.
